## Q1
If the total number of applications received in Jan 2025 were double the number of applications received in Feb 2025, then the applications received under the area 'Others' in Feb 2025 were how much percent of the applications received under the same area in Jan 2025?

A firm provides consultancy in various areas — Education, Finance, Health, Social Media, Marriage and Others — on the basis of applications received. The table gives, for each area, the percentage of that month's applications during 2025. The total number of applications received during Feb 2025 was larger than the number received in Apr 2025, and the total received during Jan 2025 was larger than the number received in Mar 2025.

| Area (% of month) | Jan | Feb | Mar | Apr |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education | 38 | 33 | 19 | 17 |
| Finance | 25 | 30 | 37 | 45 |
| Health | 11 | 18 | 5 | 18 |
| Social Media | 5 | 3 | 10 | 6 |
| Marriage | 3 | 7 | 10 | 11 |
| Others | 18 | 9 | 19 | 3 |
| Total | 100% | 100% | 100% | 100% |

## Q1 - Options
(A) 200%
(B) 100%
(C) 50%
(D) 25%

## Q1 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Data Interpretation
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2026 (22 Jun, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q1

Suppose the February total is F applications; then the January total is double, namely 2F. The area 'Others' accounts for eighteen percent of applications in January, which works out to 0.18 times 2F, that is 0.36F applications. In February 'Others' accounts for nine percent, which is 0.09F applications. Expressing the February figure as a fraction of the January figure gives 0.09F divided by 0.36F, which equals one quarter, or 25 percent.
